description: List the authenticated seller's sold orders (GunBroker /OrdersSold) — order IDs, buyers, item titles, totals, payment and shipping status. Seller tool: needs a GunBroker developer key (_apiKey) PLUS the seller's GunBroker username and password, which are exchanged for a short-lived access token on each call.

TimeFrame.description: GunBroker time-frame filter for sold orders (e.g. recent N days). Optional.

name: gunbroker_seller_orders
